profile.visual_direction: refined editorial product presentation with generous whitespace, quiet contrast, tactile paper or device context, and source-led color
profile.typography_direction: high-legibility serif or restrained sans display type with one subtle secondary accent; never decorative script for essential facts
profile.mockup_direction: clean desk, tablet, paper, or studio object mockups with soft natural light and believable scale

generation_provenance.art_direction_summary: A source-led Etsy listing gallery for Temply Studio: exact planner pages dominate clean editorial information graphics, with a quiet generated ivory-and-amethyst paper background and no lifestyle props.

concept_board.hero: One large exact January 2027 monthly page is the thumbnail subject, with short digital-download disclosure.
concept_board.palette: Warm ivory, muted sage, pale amethyst, mauve, charcoal, and restrained paper texture.
concept_board.mockup: No photographic device mockups in the listing graphics; the PDF pages are shown as clean framed source-page previews.
concept_board.gallery_rhythm: Hero, overview, section map, monthly, daily, wellness, weekly, navigation, extras, and thank-you; each slot answers one buyer question with source evidence.
concept_board.iconography: Small rounded labels and page-count markers only; no invented app icons or compatibility symbols.
